WITH _base_2 AS (
  SELECT
    customers.id AS "customers.id",
    regions.name AS "customers.regions.name"
  FROM customers AS customers
  LEFT JOIN regions AS regions
    ON customers.region_id = regions.id
  GROUP BY
    customers.id,
    regions.name
), _cm_customers__orders__amount_sum AS (
  SELECT
    orders.customer_id AS "orders.customer_id",
    customers__regions.name AS "orders.customers.regions.name",
    CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.amount_sum"
  FROM orders AS orders
  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
  LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
    ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
  GROUP BY
    orders.customer_id,
    customers__regions.name
), _cm_customers__campaign_members__campaigns__iif_channel_email_1_0_sum AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN campaigns.channel = 'email' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "campaigns.iif_channel_email_1_0_sum"
  FROM campaigns AS campaigns
), __slayer_stage_cust AS (
  SELECT
    _stage_inner."customers.id" AS "id",
    _stage_inner."customers.regions.name" AS "regions__name",
    _stage_inner."customers.rev" AS "rev",
    _stage_inner."customers.email_cnt" AS "email_cnt"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      _base_2."customers.id",
      _base_2."customers.regions.name",
      _cm_customers__orders__amount_sum."orders.amount_sum" AS "customers.rev",
      _cm_customers__campaign_members__campaigns__iif_channel_email_1_0_sum."campaigns.iif_channel_email_1_0_sum" AS "customers.email_cnt"
    FROM _base_2
    LEFT JOIN _cm_customers__orders__amount_sum
      ON _base_2."customers.id" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_customers__orders__amount_sum."orders.customer_id"
      AND _base_2."customers.regions.name" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_customers__orders__amount_sum."orders.customers.regions.name"
    CROSS JOIN _cm_customers__campaign_members__campaigns__iif_channel_email_1_0_sum
  ) AS _stage_inner
)
SELECT
  cust.regions__name AS "cust.regions__name",
  SUM(cust.rev) AS "cust.revenue"
FROM __slayer_stage_cust AS cust
WHERE
  cust.email_cnt > 0
GROUP BY
  cust.regions__name
ORDER BY
  "cust.regions__name" ASC
LIMIT 21

WITH _base_2 AS (
  SELECT
    customers.id AS "customers.id",
    regions.name AS "customers.regions.name"
  FROM customers AS customers
  LEFT JOIN regions AS regions
    ON customers.region_id = regions.id
  GROUP BY
    customers.id,
    regions.name
), _cm_customers__orders__amount_sum AS (
  SELECT
    orders.customer_id AS "orders.customer_id",
    customers__regions.name AS "orders.customers.regions.name",
    CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.amount_sum"
  FROM orders AS orders
  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
  LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
    ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
  GROUP BY
    orders.customer_id,
    customers__regions.name
), _cm_customers__campaign_members__campaigns__iif_channel_email_1_0_sum AS (
  SELECT
    _base."campaigns.campaign_members.customers.id" AS "campaigns.campaign_members.customers.id",
    _base."campaigns.campaign_members.customers.regions.name" AS "campaigns.campaign_members.customers.regions.name",
    SUM(_base._v) AS "campaigns.iif_channel_email_1_0_sum_host"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      campaign_members__customers.id AS "campaigns.campaign_members.customers.id",
      campaign_members__customers__regions.name AS "campaigns.campaign_members.customers.regions.name",
      campaigns.id AS _ek0,
      MAX(CASE WHEN campaigns.channel = 'email' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS _v
    FROM campaigns AS campaigns
    LEFT JOIN campaign_members AS campaign_members
      ON campaigns.id = campaign_members.campaign_id
    LEFT JOIN customers AS campaign_members__customers
      ON campaign_members.customer_id = campaign_members__customers.id
    LEFT JOIN regions AS campaign_members__customers__regions
      ON campaign_members__customers.region_id = campaign_members__customers__regions.id
    WHERE
      NOT campaigns.id IS NULL
    GROUP BY
      campaign_members__customers.id,
      campaign_members__customers__regions.name,
      campaigns.id
  ) AS _base
  GROUP BY
    _base."campaigns.campaign_members.customers.id",
    _base."campaigns.campaign_members.customers.regions.name"
), __slayer_stage_cust AS (
  SELECT
    _stage_inner."customers.id" AS "id",
    _stage_inner."customers.regions.name" AS "regions__name",
    _stage_inner."customers.rev" AS "rev",
    _stage_inner."customers.email_cnt" AS "email_cnt"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      _base_2."customers.id",
      _base_2."customers.regions.name",
      _cm_customers__orders__amount_sum."orders.amount_sum" AS "customers.rev",
      _cm_customers__campaign_members__campaigns__iif_channel_email_1_0_sum."campaigns.iif_channel_email_1_0_sum_host" AS "customers.email_cnt"
    FROM _base_2
    LEFT JOIN _cm_customers__orders__amount_sum
      ON _base_2."customers.id" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_customers__orders__amount_sum."orders.customer_id"
      AND _base_2."customers.regions.name" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_customers__orders__amount_sum."orders.customers.regions.name"
    LEFT JOIN _cm_customers__campaign_members__campaigns__iif_channel_email_1_0_sum
      ON _base_2."customers.id" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_customers__campaign_members__campaigns__iif_channel_email_1_0_sum."campaigns.campaign_members.customers.id"
      AND _base_2."customers.regions.name" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_customers__campaign_members__campaigns__iif_channel_email_1_0_sum."campaigns.campaign_members.customers.regions.name"
  ) AS _stage_inner
)
SELECT
  cust.regions__name AS "cust.regions__name",
  SUM(cust.rev) AS "cust.revenue",
  COUNT(*) AS "cust.n"
FROM __slayer_stage_cust AS cust
WHERE
  cust.email_cnt > 0
GROUP BY
  cust.regions__name
ORDER BY
  "cust.regions__name" ASC
LIMIT 21
